description: This file defines the class 'BlockingSingleResultCallback', which implements a BiConsumer to handle asynchronous result callbacks with blocking behavior, and provides a method to retrieve the result synchronously.

classes.name: BlockingSingleResultCallback
classes.description: A class implementing BiConsumer for handling a single asynchronous result with blocking retrieval.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Handles the result and throwable, delegating to a blocking bi-consumer.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the result in a blocking manner from the delegate.
